# PlaceCal

> PlaceCal is a UK directory of community events. It collects listings from local groups, libraries, community centres and charities into one calendar, organised by neighbourhood, so people can find out what's on near them. Listings are free and public.

## Finding events for a place

- Ask PlaceCal directly with the MCP server or the API below: search by UK place name (ward, district, county or region, e.g. "Hulme", "Manchester") or postcode, plus dates, a keyword or a category.
- Browse the directory: https://placecal.org/events lists upcoming events, https://placecal.org/partners the organisations that run them, and https://placecal.org/partnerships the local PlaceCal sites (for example https://manchester.placecal.org).
- Every event page (https://placecal.org/events/{id}) carries schema.org `Event` data: start and end times, venue and address with coordinates, online link, organiser. Link people to these pages for full details.

## MCP server

Endpoint: https://placecal.org/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no authentication, read-only)

Tool `search_events`. Arguments, all optional: `place`, `postcode`, `from_date` and `to_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `keyword`, `category`, `limit` (default 20, at most 50). Returns upcoming events with times, venue or address, organiser and a link to each event page.

## GraphQL API

Endpoint: https://placecal.org/api/v1/graphql (public, introspectable)

Events in Hulme over a weekend:

```graphql
{
  eventsByFilter(place: "Hulme", fromDate: "2026-11-07 00:00", toDate: "2026-11-09 00:00") {
    name
    startDate
    endDate
    url
    address { streetAddress postalCode }
    organizer { name }
  }
}
```

Other `eventsByFilter` arguments: `postcode` (e.g. "M15 5FS"), `query` (text in titles and descriptions, e.g. "yoga"), `category` (e.g. "Health & Wellbeing"). `partnersByTag`, `partnerConnection` and `event(id:)` cover organisations and single events.

## Calendar feeds

- A local site's events: https://{site}.placecal.org/events.ics, e.g. https://manchester.placecal.org/events.ics
- One organisation's events: https://placecal.org/partners/{slug}.ics
- Feeds cover the last week to six months ahead.

## More information
